### Introduction

CABLE (Community Atmosphere Biosphere Land Exchange) is a land surface model. The PEcAn package `PEcAn.CABLE` provides integration with the PEcAn workflow system.

See the [CABLE README](https://github.com/PecanProject/pecan/blob/develop/models/cable/README.md) for installation and configuration guidance.

### Installation

```r
# Install from r-universe
options(repos = c(
  pecanproject = 'https://pecanproject.r-universe.dev',
  CRAN = 'https://cloud.r-project.org'))
install.packages('PEcAn.CABLE')
```
